name: seo-content-brief
tagline_zh: 写内容前先出简报：每段字数、竞品打分、关键词密度全给到。新页优化两用，别处没有的页面类型模板，直接照着写。
tagline_en: Before writing, get a brief: per-section word counts, competitor scores, keyword density, and page-type.
desc_en: Generate competitive SEO content briefs with per-section word counts, competitor scoring, keyword density guidance, and page-type templates. Supports both new page briefs and improve-existing-page briefs. Use when user says "content brief", "write a brief", "content outline", "blog brief", "service page brief", "brief for", "writing brief", "content plan", or "outline for".
why_zh: 它把竞品分析变成打分制，还细分到每段字数，比泛泛的提纲更可执行。
why_en: Turns competitor analysis into scores and breaks down word counts per section—more actionable than generic outlines.
